examples.en: The main feature of this new phone is its battery life.
examples.zh: 這支新手機的主要特色是它的電池續航力。

examples.en: Her facial features closely resemble those of her older sister.
examples.zh: 她的面貌特徵與她的姊姊非常相似。

examples.en: This application includes a useful search feature for fast navigation.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式包含一個有用的搜尋功能以利快速瀏覽。

examples.en: The museum concert will feature several world-famous musicians tonight.
examples.zh: 博物館今晚的音樂會將以幾位世界著名的音樂家為特色。

examples.en: The new action movie features a popular young actor.
examples.zh: 這部新的動作電影由一位受歡迎的年輕演員主演。

examples.en: The menu features local organic vegetables and fresh seafood.
examples.zh: 菜單以當地的有機蔬菜和新鮮海鮮為特色。

examples.en: It is a great shame that you missed the party.
examples.zh: 你錯過了派對真是太遺憾了。

examples.en: He felt a deep sense of shame after lying to his parents.
examples.zh: 他在對父母撒謊後感到深深的羞恥。

examples.en: What a shame that the weather ruined our outdoor picnic.
examples.zh: 天氣毀了我們的戶外野餐，真是太可惜了。

examples.en: My primary goal is to pass the English exam this semester.
examples.zh: 我這學期的主要目標是通過英文考試。

examples.en: The soccer player kicked the ball directly into the goal.
examples.zh: 這名足球員把球直接踢進了球門。

examples.en: She scored the winning goal in the last minute of play.
examples.zh: 她在比賽最後一分鐘踢進了致勝球。

examples.en: Plants require sufficient sunlight and water to grow well.
examples.zh: 植物需要充足的陽光和水才能生長得好。

examples.en: The international school requires students to wear uniforms every day.
examples.zh: 這所國際學校要求學生每天穿制服。

examples.en: This job requires good communication skills and team experience.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要良好的溝通技巧和團隊經驗。

examples.en: The fantasy novel tells a story about a friendly green dragon.
examples.zh: 這本奇幻小說講述了一個關於一隻友善綠龍的故事。

examples.en: People row colorful boats during the Dragon Boat Festival in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 人們在台灣端午節期間划著繽紛的龍舟。

examples.en: An ancient giant dragon guarded the hidden treasure inside the cave.
examples.zh: 一隻古老的巨龍守護著山洞裡藏著的寶藏。

examples.en: Our office printer is running out of paper and ink.
examples.zh: 我們辦公室的印表機紙張和墨水快用完了。

examples.en: Please connect your laptop to the wireless printer to print documents.
examples.zh: 請將您的筆記型電腦連接至無線印表機以列印文件。

examples.en: The technician fixed the broken printer in less than ten minutes.
examples.zh: 技術人員在不到十分鐘內修好了故障的印表機。

examples.en: The surface of the quiet lake was as smooth as glass.
examples.zh: 平靜的湖面像玻璃一樣光滑。

examples.en: Please wipe the dusty table surface clean with a wet cloth.
examples.zh: 請用濕布把滿是灰塵的桌子表面擦乾淨。

examples.en: Rough surfaces increase friction when objects move across them.
examples.zh: 粗糙的表面會在物體移動時增加摩擦力。

examples.en: The submarine slowly surfaced after completing its underwater training.
examples.zh: 這艘潛水艇在完成水下訓練後慢慢浮出水面。

examples.en: New evidence surfaced during the second investigation of the case.
examples.zh: 在該案的第二次調查中顯露出了新的證據。

examples.en: The swimmer surfaced to take a deep breath of air.
examples.zh: 游泳者浮出水面吸了一大口空氣。

examples.en: The team celebrated their basketball championship victory with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 球隊熱情地慶祝他們的籃球錦標賽勝利。

examples.en: Hard work and practice brought them a glorious victory yesterday.
examples.zh: 努力與練習在昨天為他們帶來了輝煌的勝利。

examples.en: The candidate announced her election victory to her supporters tonight.
examples.zh: 候選人今晚向她的支持者宣布了選舉勝利。

examples.en: Is there any particular song you would like to hear?
examples.zh: 有哪首特定的歌曲你想聽嗎？

examples.en: She is very particular about the cleanliness of her bedroom.
examples.zh: 她對自己臥室的整潔非常挑剔。

examples.en: We paid attention to this particular detail during our research.
examples.zh: 我們在研究過程中注意到了這個特定的細節。

examples.en: The new passenger aircraft landed safely at the busy airport.
examples.zh: 這架新客機安全降落在繁忙的機場。

examples.en: Military aircraft flew over the city during the national celebration.
examples.zh: 軍用飛機在國家慶典期間飛越城市上空。

examples.en: Engineers are designing a light aircraft powered by solar energy.
examples.zh: 工程師正設計一架由太陽能驅動的輕型航空器。

senses.zh: 寶貴的；有價值的；貴重的

examples.en: Thank you for sharing your valuable experience with our class.
examples.zh: 感謝您與我們班分享您寶貴的經驗。

examples.en: She keeps all her valuable jewelry in a safe.
examples.zh: 她把所有貴重的首飾保存在保險箱裡。

examples.en: This old painting is extremely valuable to art collectors worldwide.
examples.zh: 這幅古老的畫作對全世界的藝術收藏家來說極具價值。

examples.en: You need to use good judgment when making important decisions.
examples.zh: 在做出重大決定時，你需要運用良好的判斷。

examples.en: The judge delivered his final judgment in the courtroom.
examples.zh: 法官在法庭上宣布了最終判決。

examples.en: In my judgment, this plan needs more careful consideration.
examples.zh: 依我的判斷，這個計劃需要更審慎的考量。

examples.en: The semiconductor industry plays a critical role in Taiwan's economy.
examples.zh: 半導體產業在台灣經濟中扮演著關鍵角色。

examples.en: Tourism is a major industry in this scenic coastal town.
examples.zh: 觀光業是這個風景優美的海岸小鎮的主要產業。

examples.en: The movie industry attracts millions of young people every year.
examples.zh: 電影產業每年吸引數以百萬計的年輕人。

examples.en: It is always best to tell the truth to your parents.
examples.zh: 對父母說實話總是最好的選擇。

examples.en: The reporter worked hard to discover the truth behind the scandal.
examples.zh: 記者努力工作以發掘醜聞背後的真相。

examples.en: There is a grain of truth in what he said.
examples.zh: 他說的話裡有一絲事實。

senses.zh: 超出；超越；在…較遠的一邊

examples.en: The beauty of the mountain view was beyond all description.
examples.zh: 山景之美超乎所有言語的形容。

examples.en: Our house is located just beyond the forest.
examples.zh: 我們的房子就位在森林的另一邊。

examples.en: The cost of repairs was far beyond our original budget.
examples.zh: 維修費用遠遠超出了我們原先的預算。

examples.en: My grandfather taught me how to play chess when I was young.
examples.zh: 我祖父在我年輕時教我下西洋棋。

examples.en: They sat in the park and played a quiet game of chess.
examples.zh: 他們坐在公園裡下了一局平靜的西洋棋。

examples.en: She is the president of our high school chess club.
examples.zh: 她是我們高中西洋棋社的社長。

examples.en: Students learn basic math skills in elementary school.
examples.zh: 學生在國小學習基礎的數學技能。

examples.en: Clean drinking water is a basic need for all human beings.
examples.zh: 乾淨的飲用水是所有人類的基本需求。

examples.en: This introductory course covers the basic concepts of computer programming.
examples.zh: 這門入門課程涵蓋了電腦程式設計的基礎概念。

examples.en: Please pay attention to every small detail of the contract.
examples.zh: 請注意合約中的每一個小細節。

examples.en: The travel agent explained the details of the tour package.
examples.zh: 旅行社專員解釋了套裝行程的詳情。

examples.en: His report covers all important details of the project development.
examples.zh: 他的報告涵蓋了專案開發的所有重要細節。

examples.en: The user guide details how to set up the software.
examples.zh: 這份使用指南詳細說明了如何設定軟體。

examples.en: She detailed her experiences during her trip across Europe last summer.
examples.zh: 她詳細說明了去年夏天橫跨歐洲旅行時的經歷。

examples.en: The manager detailed the new work procedures to all staff.
examples.zh: 經理向全體員工詳細說明了新的工作流程。

senses.zh: 枯燥乏味的；鈍的；暗淡的

examples.en: The lecture was so dull that many students fell asleep.
examples.zh: 這場講座太枯燥乏味了，許多學生都睡著了。

examples.en: This knife is too dull to cut the fresh meat properly.
examples.zh: 這把刀太鈍了，沒辦法好好切新鮮肉品。

examples.en: The sky looked gray and dull on that cold rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 在那個寒冷下雨的下午，天空看起來陰暗又沉悶。

examples.en: The general manager approved our proposal for the new marketing campaign.
examples.zh: 總經理核准了我們新行銷活動的企劃案。

examples.en: She works hard as a store manager at a large supermarket.
examples.zh: 她在一間大型超市擔任門市經理，工作非常努力。

examples.en: Our project manager assigned tasks to team members this morning.
examples.zh: 我們的專案主管今天早上指派了任務給團隊成員。

examples.en: She melted some fresh butter in a hot frying pan.
examples.zh: 她在熱平底鍋裡融化了一些新鮮奶油。

examples.en: He washed the dirty pan after cooking eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 他在煮完早餐雞蛋後洗乾淨了髒鍋子。

examples.en: Pour the cake batter into a round baking pan.
examples.zh: 將蛋糕麵糊倒入圓形烤盤中。

examples.en: The piano is her favorite musical instrument to play at home.
examples.zh: 鋼琴是她在家中最喜歡彈奏的樂器。

examples.en: Surgeons must sterilize all medical instruments before performing surgery.
examples.zh: 外科醫師在進行手術前必須消毒所有醫療儀器。

examples.en: Scientists used a delicate measurement instrument to collect atmospheric data.
examples.zh: 科學家使用精密測量儀器收集大氣數據。

examples.en: We should reduce plastic waste to protect our natural environment.
examples.zh: 我們應該減少塑膠垃圾以保護我們的自然環境。

examples.en: The new elementary school creates a comfortable learning environment for children.
examples.zh: 這所新小學為孩子們營造了一個舒適的學習環境。

examples.en: Air pollution poses a serious threat to the urban environment.
examples.zh: 空氣污染對都市環境構成了嚴重威脅。

examples.en: Stinky tofu is a famous traditional night market snack in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 臭豆腐是台灣知名的傳統夜市小吃。

examples.en: She added fresh tofu and green onions to the miso soup.
examples.zh: 她在味噌湯裡加入了鮮豆腐和蔥花。

examples.en: Tofu is a rich source of plant protein for vegetarians.
examples.zh: 豆腐是素食者優質的植物蛋白質來源。

examples.en: The whole family sat together and enjoyed a light supper.
examples.zh: 全家人坐在一起享用簡單的晚餐。

examples.en: What would you like to eat for supper this evening?
examples.zh: 你今晚晚餐想吃什麼？

examples.en: She cooked hot noodle soup for a late-night supper after work.
examples.zh: 她在下班後煮了熱麵湯當宵夜。

examples.en: She nodded her head in agreement with my proposal.
examples.zh: 她點頭表示同意我的提議。

examples.en: The tired student began to nod off during the long speech.
examples.zh: 這名疲憊的學生在長篇演講中開始打瞌睡。

examples.en: He nodded politely to greet his new neighbor this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上禮貌地向新鄰居點頭致意。

examples.en: With a quick nod of his head, he left the office.
examples.zh: 他快速地點了點頭後便離開了辦公室。

examples.en: The manager gave us a nod of approval for the project.
examples.zh: 經理對我們的專案表示點頭認可。

examples.en: A silent nod was enough to convey her complete understanding.
examples.zh: 默默的點頭就足以傳達她完全理解了。

examples.en: Green rice fields stretched across the wide country landscape.
examples.zh: 綠油油的稻田延伸穿過廣闊的鄉村景色。

examples.en: Students gathered on the sports field for morning exercise.
examples.zh: 學生們聚集在操場上做晨操。

examples.en: Dr. Wang is a leading expert in the field of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 王博士是人工智慧領域的頂尖專家。

examples.en: Hard work and perseverance are key elements for achieving success.
examples.zh: 努力與堅持是取得成功的關鍵要素。

examples.en: The school charity concert was a huge success last weekend.
examples.zh: 這場學校慈善音樂會上週末獲得了巨大的成功。

examples.en: Her new business venture proved to be a remarkable success.
examples.zh: 她的新創事業被證明是一次卓越的成功。

examples.en: Children threw small stones into the calm river water.
examples.zh: 孩子們把小石頭扔進平靜的河水裡。

examples.en: The ancient castle was built with heavy gray stone blocks.
examples.zh: 這座古老的城堡是用沉重的灰色石塊建造的。

examples.en: Remove the hard stone before eating the juicy peach.
examples.zh: 吃多汁的蜜桃前請先把硬果核去除。

examples.en: She has an outgoing personality and makes friends very easily.
examples.zh: 她性格外向，非常容易交朋友。

examples.en: Each of the twins has a completely different personality.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎中的每一個都有著截然不同的個性。

examples.en: Several famous television personalities attended the red carpet event.
examples.zh: 幾位著名的電視名人出席了這場紅毯盛會。

examples.en: The red balloon popped with a loud sound at the party.
examples.zh: 紅氣球在派對上發出砰的一聲破裂了。

examples.en: An interesting idea suddenly popped into my head yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我腦海中突然浮現出一個有趣的點子。

examples.en: I need to pop into the grocery store for fresh milk.
examples.zh: 我需要快速順道去雜貨店買新鮮牛奶。

examples.en: She loves listening to Taiwanese pop music during her free time.
examples.zh: 她空閒時間喜歡聽台灣流行音樂。

examples.en: Pop culture influences young people's fashion and speech trends.
examples.zh: 流行文化影響著年輕人的時尚與用語潮流。

examples.en: He bought tickets for the pop star's world concert tour.
examples.zh: 他買了這位流行巨星世界巡迴音樂會的門票。

examples.en: Classical music and pop are two very different musical genres.
examples.zh: 古典音樂和流行音樂是兩種非常不同的音樂流派。

examples.en: We heard a loud pop coming from the kitchen microwave.
examples.zh: 我們聽到廚房微波爐發出一聲巨響。

examples.en: He opened a cold can of pop on a hot summer afternoon.
examples.zh: 他在炎熱的夏日午後打開了一罐冰涼的汽水。

examples.en: This vegetable soup is a bit too salty for my taste.
examples.zh: 這碗蔬菜湯對我的口味來說有點太鹹了。

examples.en: Ocean water tastes salty because it contains various dissolved minerals.
examples.zh: 海水喝起來鹹鹹的，因為它含有各種溶解的礦物質。

examples.en: I love eating salty potato chips while watching action movies.
examples.zh: 我喜歡邊看動作電影邊吃鹹味洋芋片。

examples.en: Spread garlic paste evenly on a slice of French bread.
examples.zh: 把蒜蓉醬均勻塗抹在法國麵包片上。

examples.en: Rub a small amount of cleaning paste onto the stain.
examples.zh: 把少量清潔膏塗抹在污漬上。

examples.en: The children used paste to complete their art project.
examples.zh: 孩子們用漿糊完成他們的美勞作品。

examples.en: Copy the text from a website and paste it into a document.
examples.zh: 從網站複製文字並將其貼上到文件中。

examples.en: She pasted several old family photos onto the memory board.
examples.zh: 她把幾張家族舊照片黏貼在回憶板上。

examples.en: Please paste the mailing label neatly on the package front.
examples.zh: 請將郵寄標籤整齊地貼在包裹正面。

examples.en: Cleaning the whole garage was a challenging physical task for us.
examples.zh: 打掃整個車庫對我們來說是一項具挑戰性的體力工作。

examples.en: Our primary task today is to complete the weekly financial report.
examples.zh: 我們今天的首要任務是完成每週財務報告。

examples.en: The manager assigned a new design task to the creative team.
examples.zh: 經理把一項新的設計任務指派給創意團隊。

examples.en: She works as a senior manager in the sales division.
examples.zh: 她在業務部門擔任資深經理。

examples.en: Students practiced long division problems in math class.
examples.zh: 學生們在數學課上練習長除法題目。

examples.en: There is a deep division of opinions regarding the proposal.
examples.zh: 對於這項提案存在著深刻的意見分歧。

examples.en: She spent the rainy weekend reading a thick detective novel.
examples.zh: 她花了這個下雨的週末閱讀一本厚厚的偵探小說。

examples.en: The famous author spent two years writing her new novel.
examples.zh: 這位著名的作者花了兩年時間寫她的新小說。

examples.en: This popular historical novel was adapted into an award-winning movie.
examples.zh: 這部熱門歷史小說被改編成了一部獲獎電影。

examples.en: The scientist proposed a novel approach to solving the energy problem.
examples.zh: 這位科學家提出了一種解決能源問題的新穎方法。

examples.en: Using solar panels to charge smartphones is a novel idea.
examples.zh: 使用太陽能板給智慧型手機充電是一個新穎的想法。

examples.en: The company introduced a novel marketing strategy to boost sales.
examples.zh: 該公司推出了一項新穎的行銷策略來提昇銷售額。

examples.en: My grandfather gave me some wise advice about life yesterday.
examples.zh: 我祖父昨天給了我一些關於人生的明智建議。

examples.en: It is always good to seek professional medical advice first.
examples.zh: 先尋求專業醫療建議總是好的。

examples.en: She followed her teacher's useful advice and passed the test.
examples.zh: 她聽從了老師有用的建議並通過了測驗。

examples.en: He took some medicine to relieve the sharp pain in his head.
examples.zh: 他吃了藥來緩解頭部的劇烈疼痛。

examples.en: She felt a sudden pain in her back while lifting a box.
examples.zh: 她在搬箱子時，背部突然感到一陣疼痛。

examples.en: Time can gradually heal emotional pain caused by personal loss.
examples.zh: 時間可以逐漸治癒個人損失帶來的心理痛苦。

examples.en: The small pendulum swung back and forth inside the wall clock.
examples.zh: 小擺錘在壁鐘裡來回擺動。

examples.en: Green leaves and colorful flowers burst forth during the spring season.
examples.zh: 綠葉和繽紛的花朵在春季盛開綻放。

examples.en: They set forth on a long journey across the quiet ocean.
examples.zh: 他們啟程展開橫跨平靜海洋的長途旅程。

examples.en: Her strong belief in honesty guided her decisions throughout life.
examples.zh: 她對誠實的堅定信念指引著她一生的決定。

examples.en: Freedom of religious belief is protected by law in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 宗教信仰自由在台灣受到法律保護。

examples.en: It is my firm belief that education can change the world.
examples.zh: 我堅定相信教育可以改變世界。

examples.en: The publisher released a revised edition of the English textbook.
examples.zh: 出版商推出了這本英文教科書的修訂版。

examples.en: I bought a limited edition of my favorite novel.
examples.zh: 我買了我最喜歡的小說的限量版。

examples.en: The morning edition of the local newspaper arrived on time.
examples.zh: 地方報紙的早報如期送達。

examples.en: Taiwan has a humid subtropical climate with warm wet summers.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有潮濕的副熱帶氣候，夏季溫暖潮濕。

examples.en: Global climate change affects agricultural production and marine ecosystems.
examples.zh: 全球氣候變遷影響著農業生產與海洋生態系統。

examples.en: The economic climate has improved significantly over the past year.
examples.zh: 經濟景氣在過去一年有了顯著改善。

senses.zh: 負面的；消極的；陰性的；負數的

examples.en: A negative attitude towards learning will hinder student academic progress.
examples.zh: 消極的學習態度會妨礙學生的學業進步。

examples.en: Her medical test result came back negative for the flu virus.
examples.zh: 她的醫療檢測結果顯示流感病毒呈陰性。

examples.en: Minus five is an example of a negative number in math.
examples.zh: 負五是數學中負數的一個範例。

examples.en: We must consider both the positives and negatives of this plan.
examples.zh: 我們必須同時考量這個計劃的正面與負面因素。

examples.en: The photographer stored the old camera negatives in a cool drawer.
examples.zh: 攝影師將舊相機底片存放在涼爽的抽屜裡。

examples.en: Despite a few negatives, the hotel is still a good choice for families.
examples.zh: 儘管有一些缺點，這家飯店仍是適合家庭的好選擇。

examples.en: Citizens will vote for their preferred candidate in the upcoming election.
examples.zh: 公民將在即將到來的選舉中投給他們心儀的候選人。

examples.en: The committee voted to approve the new building budget yesterday.
examples.zh: 委員會昨天投票通過了新建築預算案。

examples.en: We voted on where to go for our class graduation trip.
examples.zh: 我們就班級畢業旅行要去哪裡進行了表決。

examples.en: Each club member has one vote in the annual election.
examples.zh: 每位社團成員在年度選舉中都有一票。

examples.en: The motion passed by a unanimous vote during the meeting.
examples.zh: 該動議在會議期間獲得全體一致通過。

examples.en: The final vote count showed a clear victory for the leader.
examples.zh: 最終得票數顯示這位領導者明顯獲勝。

examples.en: Could you lend me your dictionary for a few minutes?
examples.zh: 你能借我你的字典幾分鐘嗎？

examples.en: The bank agreed to lend money to young people starting new businesses.
examples.zh: 銀行同意貸款給創業的年輕人。

examples.en: She kindly lent her warm coat to her shivering friend.
examples.zh: 她好心地把保暖的外套借給發抖的朋友。

examples.en: Chocolate ice cream is my favorite dessert on hot summer days.
examples.zh: 巧克力冰淇淋是我在炎熱夏天最喜愛的甜點。

examples.en: What is your favorite subject to study in high school?
examples.zh: 你在高中最喜愛的學習科目是什麼？

examples.en: This scenic park is her favorite place for a morning jog.
examples.zh: 這座風景優美的公園是她最喜愛的晨跑地點。

senses.zh: 最喜愛的人事物；有望獲勝者

examples.en: Among all these books, this novel is my personal favorite.
examples.zh: 在所有這些書中，這本小說是我個人的最愛。

examples.en: The experienced runner is the clear favorite to win the race.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的跑者顯然是贏得比賽的大熱門。

examples.en: Add this useful website to your browser favorites for quick access.
examples.zh: 將這個實用的網站加入瀏覽器最愛以便快速造訪。

examples.en: He can lift heavy boxes easily because he exercises regularly.
examples.zh: 他能輕鬆舉起沉重的箱子，因為他定期運動。

examples.en: Please lift your feet so I can sweep the floor.
examples.zh: 請抬起你的腳，我才能掃地。

examples.en: The government decided to lift the temporary travel warning.
examples.zh: 政府決定解除臨時旅遊警示。

examples.en: We took the lift directly to the twentieth floor of the building.
examples.zh: 我們搭電梯直接到大樓的二十樓。

examples.en: My classmate offered me a lift home after school.
examples.zh: 我同學提議放學後載我一程回家。

examples.en: The good news gave the whole team a big lift.
examples.zh: 這個好消息讓全隊士氣大振。

examples.en: The latter half of the movie was much more exciting.
examples.zh: 這部電影的後半段精彩多了。

examples.en: In the latter part of his career, he wrote books.
examples.zh: 在他的生涯後半期，他撰寫書籍。

examples.en: She preferred the latter option presented during the team discussion.
examples.zh: 她偏好團隊討論時提出的後者選項。

examples.en: If I must choose between tea and coffee, I usually prefer the latter.
examples.zh: 如果要在茶和咖啡之間選擇，我通常偏好後者。

examples.en: Between apples and oranges, he chose the latter as a snack.
examples.zh: 在蘋果和橘子之間，他選擇了後者當點心。

examples.en: Both plans sound good, but the latter is more affordable.
examples.zh: 兩個計劃聽起來都不錯，但後者比較划算。

examples.en: The shy little girl hid behind her mother when strangers arrived.
examples.zh: 當陌生人來到時，這個害羞的小女孩躲在媽媽背後。

examples.en: He feels too shy to speak in front of large audiences.
examples.zh: 他覺得太害羞，不敢在大批觀眾面前演講。

examples.en: She gave a shy smile and answered the question quietly.
examples.zh: 她害羞地笑了笑，並安靜地回答了問題。

examples.en: This mountain region is famous for producing high-quality tea.
examples.zh: 這個山區以生產高品質茶葉而聞名。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused severe flooding in the southern coastal region.
examples.zh: 大雨在南部沿海地區造成了嚴重淹水。

examples.en: Rare wild animals inhabit the remote forest region of the island.
examples.zh: 罕見的野生動物棲息在這座島嶼的偏遠森林區域。
